productConcept.name: Griting
productConcept.description: Griting is an AI-powered agentic career infrastructure platform that evaluates talent, runs startup incubation, and connects professionals to mentorship — all from Silicon Valley.
productConcept.rationale: Content provided verbatim from Figma extraction; product concept derived directly from page headings and section copy — no inference required. Deep forest green brand (#003620/#00693e) paired with editorial Helvetica Neue reflects Griting's infrastructure-grade identity.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion.json contains 11 CSS keyframe animations (sprinkle-1 through 5, vapor-1/2/3, blink, lamp-rays) and snap easing cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); GSAP + ScrollTrigger used for scroll-triggered reveals, parallax, stagger, and clip-path wipes
notes: index.html uses zero image assets — hero is pure CSS particle animation using keyframes from motion.json (sprinkle-1 through 5, vapor-1/2/3, blink). All other sections use CSS-only depth techniques (gradients, pseudo-elements, SVG mockups). blog-post-hero.jpeg and about-team-wide.jpeg were downloaded as PNG from CDN; .jpeg copies created to match HTML src references.
